fixed.zh: 我叫 Maya，正在研究如何在 DDL 前一天学会一学期的内容。
fixed.en: I'm Maya, researching how to learn a whole semester the night before the deadline.

fixed.zh: 这片草地很适合放空，直到 Canvas 提醒你还有三份作业。
fixed.en: This lawn is perfect for relaxing, until Canvas reminds you of three assignments.

random.zh: 我把课程表贴在墙上。墙先崩溃了。
random.en: I pinned my timetable on the wall. The wall had a breakdown first.

random.zh: 谁发明了早八？我要给他写一篇 8000 字的反思。
random.en: Who invented 8 a.m. lectures? I owe them an 8,000-word reflection.

random.zh: 我的 GPA 正在锻炼：每学期都做自由落体。
random.en: My GPA exercises regularly. It does free fall every semester.

random.zh: 要不要一起去打印作业？打印机说它今天精神状态不佳。
random.en: Want to print our coursework? The printer says it's emotionally unavailable.

random.zh: 晚上十二点和凌晨两点只有一个区别：DDL 更近了。
random.en: Midnight and 2 a.m. have one difference: the deadline is closer.

weather.zh: 下暴雨了？完美，天空也在为我的成绩哭泣。
weather.en: A thunderstorm? Perfect. The sky is crying about my grades too.

fixed.zh: 我是 Ethan，号称喜欢图书馆，其实只是那里有插座。
fixed.en: I'm Ethan. I claim to love the library, but really I love the power sockets.

fixed.zh: 我每次打开课件，都觉得它在反过来阅读我。
fixed.en: Every time I open the lecture slides, I feel like they're reading me.

random.zh: 读完这页我就去吃饭。上一页我也是这么说的。
random.en: I'll eat after this page. I said that on the last page too.

random.zh: 老师说考试开卷。结果我连书在哪都不知道。
random.en: The exam is open-book. Unfortunately, I don't know where the book is.

random.zh: 我复习时效率很高：五分钟整理笔记，一小时调整字体。
random.en: I'm efficient at revision: five minutes taking notes, one hour adjusting fonts.

random.zh: 我的电脑风扇听到 Python 报错，就开始替我尖叫。
random.en: My laptop fan starts screaming for me whenever Python throws an error.

random.zh: 不要打扰我，我正在和参考文献进行一场没有结果的约会。
random.en: Don't interrupt. I'm on a date with my references, and it's going nowhere.

weather.zh: 雨声适合学习，雷声适合假装没听见老师提问。
weather.en: Rain helps me study. Thunder helps me pretend I didn't hear the lecturer.

fixed.zh: 我是 Aisha，我追校车的速度比我赶 DDL 还快。
fixed.en: I'm Aisha. I run faster for a shuttle than I do for deadlines.

fixed.zh: 这游戏里的校车不会真的把你送去上课，但我已经感动了。
fixed.en: The shuttle here won't take you to a real lecture, and I'm still moved.

random.zh: 每当校车开走，我都会体验一次人生重启。
random.en: Every time a bus drives away, I experience a complete life reset.

random.zh: 手机显示还有三分钟。我一抬头，校车已经到下学期了。
random.en: My phone said three minutes. I looked up and the shuttle was in next semester.

random.zh: 跑步软件问我的目标是什么，我填了‘赶上校车’。
random.en: My running app asked for a goal. I entered 'catch the shuttle'.

random.zh: 公交站上最常见的运动，是站着怀疑人生。
random.en: The most popular sport at the bus stop is standing and questioning life.

random.zh: 我已经很擅长等车了，就差一门选修课给我学分。
random.en: I'm so good at waiting for buses that I deserve elective credits.

weather.zh: 雨天追车像水上芭蕾，只是观众只有我的书包。
weather.en: Chasing a shuttle in the rain is aquatic ballet, with my backpack as the only audience.

fixed.zh: 我是 Lucas，计划每天健身。计划本身已经练出肌肉了。
fixed.en: I'm Lucas. I plan to exercise daily. The plan itself has developed muscles.

fixed.zh: 我决定每天跑五公里，但先从跑去食堂开始。
fixed.en: I decided to run five kilometres a day. I'm starting with a dash to the canteen.

random.zh: 深蹲让我腿酸，实验报告让我灵魂酸。
random.en: Squats hurt my legs. Lab reports hurt my soul.

random.zh: 健身房里的杠铃比我的课程负担还轻。
random.en: The weights at the gym are lighter than my course load.

random.zh: 今天的有氧训练：从寝室冲到还有一分钟截止的教室。
random.en: Today's cardio: sprinting from my room to class with one minute left.

random.zh: 我用运动手环记录心率，DDL 一来它直接申请辞职。
random.en: My fitness tracker measured my heart rate. The deadline made it resign.

random.zh: 同学问我要腹肌还是 GPA，我说能先给我睡眠吗？
random.en: Someone asked abs or GPA. I asked whether sleep was an option.

weather.zh: 这么大雨，我的跑步计划终于有了合法借口。
weather.en: With this rain, my running plan finally has a legal excuse.

fixed.zh: 我是 Mei，研究咖啡浓度与清醒程度的非线性关系。
fixed.en: I'm Mei, investigating the nonlinear relationship between coffee strength and consciousness.

fixed.zh: 如果咖啡可以折算学分，我早该毕业三次了。
fixed.en: If coffee counted as course credits, I'd have graduated three times already.

random.zh: 第三杯咖啡下肚，我的手开始能打出指数符号了。
random.en: After coffee number three, my hands can type exponential notation.

random.zh: 我不是没睡醒，我只是在进行低功耗运行。
random.en: I'm not sleepy. I'm operating in low-power mode.

random.zh: 食堂排队十五分钟，是我一天里唯一的正念冥想。
random.en: Fifteen minutes in the canteen queue is my only daily meditation.

random.zh: 老师问实验为什么没出结果，我说仪器也需要周末。
random.en: The lecturer asked why the experiment failed. I said the instrument needs weekends.

random.zh: 我给自己设置了番茄钟，结果只记得吃番茄。
random.en: I set a Pomodoro timer. Now all I remember is eating tomatoes.

weather.zh: 暴雨配热咖啡很浪漫，配湿袜子就只剩科研精神。
weather.en: Rain and hot coffee are romantic. Rain and wet socks are just research.

fixed.zh: 我是 Daniel。人生有三大未解之谜：DDL、DDL 和为什么还是 DDL。
fixed.en: I'm Daniel. Life has three mysteries: deadlines, deadlines, and why more deadlines.

fixed.zh: 我们以为在找教室，其实教室在找迟到的我们。
fixed.en: We think we're looking for classrooms. Perhaps the classrooms are looking for late students.

random.zh: 迷路不可怕，可怕的是发现自己已经走到了别人的专业。
random.en: Getting lost is fine. Ending up in another major is the problem.

random.zh: 我曾问地图‘我在哪’，地图说‘在截止日期边缘’。
random.en: I asked the map where I was. It said 'on the edge of a deadline'.

random.zh: 人为什么要做小组作业？为了学会在沉默中发出求救信号。
random.en: Why do group projects exist? To teach us how to scream silently.

random.zh: 我今天没有拖延，只是给任务充分的思考空间。
random.en: I'm not procrastinating. I'm giving the task room to think.

random.zh: 校园里最真实的天气是‘作业多云转 DDL 暴雨’。
random.en: The real campus forecast is 'partly assignments, with deadline storms'.

weather.zh: 你听，雷声是天空在大声提交作业。
weather.en: Listen: thunder is the sky submitting its coursework loudly.

fixed.zh: 欢迎来到虚构咖啡厅，我们的招牌是‘DDL 续命拿铁’。
fixed.en: Welcome to the fictional cafe. Our special is the Deadline Survival Latte.

random.zh: 咖啡能提神，但无法替你提交作业。
random.en: Coffee wakes you up, but it cannot submit assignments for you.

random.zh: 今日特价：点一杯焦虑，免费续杯。
random.en: Today's special: buy one anxiety, get unlimited refills.

random.zh: 本店不提供时间机器，抱歉。
random.en: Sorry, our cafe does not have a time machine.

random.zh: 再喝一杯？你的键盘说不需要了。
random.en: Another cup? Your keyboard says no.

fixed.zh: 我在复习明天的考试。明天是哪天？等等。
fixed.en: I'm revising for tomorrow's exam. Wait, which tomorrow?

random.zh: 这本教材很重，知识倒是完全没有进入大脑。
random.en: This textbook is heavy. The knowledge has not entered my brain.

random.zh: 请小声点，我在假装认真学习。
random.en: Please keep it down. I'm pretending to study.

random.zh: 书签比我记得的内容还多。
random.en: My bookmarks know more than I do.

random.zh: 我给每页都写了总结，现在我需要总结这些总结。
random.en: I summarized every page. Now I need to summarize the summaries.

fixed.zh: 楼上有空位！我找了一个小时才敢相信。
fixed.en: There's a free seat upstairs! It took me an hour to believe it.

random.zh: 占座是一门艺术，我目前只会远远欣赏。
random.en: Finding a seat is an art. So far, I can only admire it from afar.

random.zh: 我爬上夹层，不是为了高度，是为了离 DDL 远一点。
random.en: I climbed upstairs not for the view, but to get farther from my deadline.

random.zh: 空椅子出现了！是稀有刷新点！
random.en: An empty chair! A rare spawn!

random.zh: 我的背包占的空间比我整个社交圈都大。
random.en: My backpack takes more space than my social circle.

fixed.zh: 热身完成！等等，我还没开始。
fixed.en: Warm-up complete! Wait, I haven't started yet.

random.zh: 运动前要拉伸，写代码前要先祈祷。
random.en: Stretch before sports. Pray before coding.

random.zh: 我做了十个俯卧撑，然后做了二十个借口。
random.en: I did ten push-ups and twenty excuses.

random.zh: 我与杠铃之间存在不可克服的相互排斥。
random.en: There's an insurmountable repulsive force between me and this barbell.

random.zh: 这里的运动馆是示意版，但我的气喘是真实的。
random.en: This gym is conceptual. My heavy breathing is real.

fixed.zh: 从楼上看比赛很刺激，尤其当我不用上场时。
fixed.en: Watching from upstairs is thrilling, especially when I don't have to play.

random.zh: 我的运动天赋主要体现在鼓掌。
random.en: My main athletic talent is clapping.

random.zh: 我给这场比赛打十分，给自己参与度打零分。
random.en: Ten out of ten for the match. Zero for my participation.

random.zh: 观众席是我唯一能稳定发挥的场地。
random.en: The spectator stand is where I perform best.

random.zh: 这不是偷懒，这是战术性观察。
random.en: This isn't laziness. It's tactical observation.

fixed.zh: 按 F 体验补水站！这是虚构设施，但水分很重要。
fixed.en: Press F to try the refill station! It's fictional, but hydration matters.

random.zh: 水能续命，DDL 只能续稿。
random.en: Water keeps you alive. Deadlines keep the drafts alive.

random.zh: 实验室里最珍贵的液体，是不洒出来的那杯水。
random.en: The most precious lab liquid is the water you don't spill.

random.zh: 人生如水杯，空了就得去补，但作业会自动灌满。
random.en: Life is a water bottle: refill when empty. Homework refills itself.

random.zh: 喝水之前先放下咖啡杯。这个操作很高级。
random.en: Put down the coffee before drinking water. Advanced move.

fixed.zh: 同学，昨天的作业怎么今天还没交？时空不等人！
fixed.en: Student, yesterday's homework is still missing. Space-time waits for nobody!

random.zh: 我的课从不迟到，是同学们的钟表太慢。
random.en: My lectures are never late. The students' clocks are slow.

random.zh: 课程要求很简单：在截止时间之前完成不可能的任务。
random.en: Course policy is simple: finish the impossible before the deadline.

random.zh: 作业一共三道题，每一道都可以发展成博士论文。
random.en: Just three questions. Each one could become a PhD thesis.

random.zh: 你可以申请延期，但延期的申请昨天就截止了。
random.en: You may request an extension. The request deadline was yesterday.

fixed.zh: 开卷考试！只不过参考书在平行宇宙。
fixed.en: Open-book exam! The reference book is in a parallel universe.

random.zh: 恭喜你，考试范围是‘已经学过和未来会学的所有内容’。
random.en: Congratulations. The syllabus covers everything you've learned and everything you'll ever learn.

random.zh: 这不是突击测验，只是公告发得非常突然。
random.en: This isn't a surprise quiz. The announcement was merely sudden.

random.zh: 论文的结局只有一个反转：还要补充实验。
random.en: Every paper has one final plot twist: more experiments.

random.zh: 不要怕，老师也不知道标准答案。
random.en: Don't panic. The lecturer doesn't know the answer either.

usage: First talks use fixed introductions; later interactions select contextual/random lines with immediate-repeat avoidance. No gameplay rewards depend on dialogue.
